text: おれ　なんか　つよいの　すごいの　いろいろ　つかまえ　ちゃって　ぜっこうちょう　だぜ！

structure.jp: つよいの　すごいの　いろいろ　つかまえ　ちゃって
structure.en: have gone and caught all sorts of strong ones and awesome ones, and

structure.jp: ぜっこうちょう　だぜ！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: つかまえ　ちゃって
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual short form of てしまう, which says a thing got done completely; here it sounds like bragging. つかまえ ちゃって = 'I went and caught them, and'.

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の after a describing word stands in for the thing itself, like English 'one'. つよいの = 'strong ones'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, cocky male speech that pushes the statement at the listener. ぜっこうちょう だぜ = 'I'm on a roll, man!'.
